name: WorldUtils::GroundHeightAt
notes: Lane RZ. Ground height under {x, y, level}: below the lowest level the height one level up (stored as a float) less the wall height, above the highest the wall height plus the height one level down (both 0 outside IsInWorld); on a tile outside the lot (IsInside fails) the corner elevation of the tile clamped to [min, max + 1] in the original's call order (MaxX, MinX, MaxY, MinY), 0 unless IsInsideCorners; else the corner elevations interpolated, linearly on the x87 when the point is within 31 ulps of a whole coordinate on one axis, bilinearly in SSE floats otherwise. Returns the unrounded st0 (a double rounded by x87::Rounded). Difftest WorldHeights_GroundHeightAt: 60000 seeded cases on the shared grid world (tests/worldgrid.h), half at 24-bit x87 precision, with points within a few ulps of whole coordinates, levels below, inside and above the range and rough elevations; results compared as doubles plus every slot call; also reached through the WorldTileGround tests (HeightAtLevel compares doubles). Mutation check 28 mutants (level compares, IsInWorld drops, recursion level, the float store, signs, each clamp bound, IsInsideCorners, the 31-ulp tolerance both ways, the one-axis corner and t, the lerp operands and rounding, each bilinear corner and weight, the floor fix-up): 27 killed; the survivor (the near-edge sum's operands swapped) is equivalent, float addition being commutative.
